messages:
Carmen: Quick sync — I'm dropping a compact RN draft below. Need pin for model-server v2.3.1 and stage-gate call at 16:00 PT. Can owners confirm.
Dinesh: LGTM on draft. Pin request: model-server v2.3.1 -> please pin as 'v2.3.1-rn-2024-06' so a/b doesn't pick older.
Alex: @Carmen I'll own the pin and can do the deploybot cue. Can we shift stage-gate to 16:15? small timezone ask.
Carmen: 16:15 works. Add brief rollback plan in RN: rollback to v2.3.0 with DB feature flag off.
Lena: +1 on rollback plan. Recommend a canary at 5% for 10m, then 25% for 10m if stable.
SRE Oncall: FYI: I've reserved the 16:00-17:00 change window. Oncall will monitor latency dashboards and error rates. Set alert if 5xx > 1% sustained for 3m.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: job 84291 | target=dedicated-prod | image=model-server:v2.3.1 | strategy=canary(5%,10m)->25%(10m)->100% | requested_by=Alex | pin_label=v2.3.1-rn-2024-06
Alex: command I'll run: ```deploybot trigger 84291 --env=prod --label=v2.3.1-rn-2024-06``` doing the dry-run at 16:10 and full rollout at 16:15 if green.
Dinesh: RN draft note: "Fixes latency regression for long-context prompts. Known issue: small tokenization variance in edge case X; fallback to v2.3.0 if errors." Keep it tight.
Carmen: I've updated RN copy and added the rollback snippet and alert thresholds. Sharing link: https://redwood.internal/rn/1718901234 (preview)
Lena: PR looks clean. Who's on standby for hotfix if rollback isn't clean? @SRE Oncall and Alex?
SRE Oncall: Yep, SRE + Alex on standby. I'll coordinate post-deploy checks and open incident channel if triggers fire.
Alex: I'll post the internal announce at 16:05 once dry-run passes. Copy: "Deploying model-server v2.3.1 to prod at 16:15 PT. Canary rollout. Standby: @SRE Oncall @Alex @Dinesh."
Carmen: Thanks — please pin the internal RN in #eng-releases after announce. Also annotate the release in the changelog with version label. :+1:
deploy-bot: job 84291 status: dry-run passed at 16:11. Ready for timed rollout at 16:15.
Alex: Rolling out now.
deploy-bot: job 84291 status: canary(5%) started at 16:15.
Lena: Monitoring dashboards... all looks green so far.
deploy-bot: job 84291 status: canary(25%) started at 16:26.
SRE Oncall: No notable errors. Latency within SLOs. Proceeding to full rollout unless objections.
Alex: Proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: job 84291 status: 100% started at 16:38. job 84291 status: success at 16:45.
Carmen: Nice job team. RN finalized and pinned. I'll post the finalized internal note and archive this thread.
Dinesh: Thanks all. Closing.
